enable_discovery.description: Enable automatic discovery of PlayStation consoles on the local network

host.description: Manual host address to connect to (e.g., 192.168.1.100); required for manual registration

port.description: Port for manual connection; default 9296 per upstream documentation

nickname.description: Nickname for the registered console (used for display and credential storage)

auto_login.description: Automatically log in via saved credentials after registration

certificate_path.description: Path to custom certificate file for PSN or console authentication

consoles.description: List of manually configured consoles (used for persistent registration without discovery)
